title: DSP Pension Fund NPS Review: Returns, Portfolio & Fees (2026)
description: DSP Pension Fund is a relatively new player among the National Pension System (NPS) fund managers. As of early 2026, it has shown lower 1-year equity returns .

faq.q: Can I change my Pension Fund Manager (PFM) in NPS?
faq.a: Yes, NPS subscribers have the flexibility to change their PFM once in a financial year. This can be done online through the Central Recordkeeping Agency (CRA) portal where your NPS account is maintained.

faq.q: What are the tax benefits of investing in NPS?
faq.a: NPS offers tax benefits under Section 80C, 80CCD(1B) for an additional deduction of up to ₹50,000, and 80CCD(2) for employer contributions, which is deductible up to 10% of salary (Basic + DA) without any monetary limit.

faq.q: How does 'Auto Choice' work with DSP Pension Fund?
faq.a: Under Auto Choice, DSP Pension Fund automatically adjusts your asset allocation across E, C, and G funds based on your age. As you grow older, the exposure to riskier assets like equity is gradually reduced, and allocation to safer government securities increases.

faq.q: What are the fees associated with DSP Pension Fund in NPS?
faq.a: The fees for Pension Fund Managers in NPS are regulated by the PFRDA and are generally very low. They include an investment management fee, which is a small percentage of assets under management, and other transaction charges.

faq.q: How often can I change my asset allocation with DSP Pension Fund?
faq.a: If you have opted for Active Choice, you can change your asset allocation up to two times in a financial year. For subscribers under Auto Choice, the asset allocation is automatically managed and does not require manual changes.

faq.q: Is DSP Pension Fund suitable for conservative investors?
faq.a: DSP Pension Fund, like other PFMs, offers various schemes including those focused on corporate bonds and government securities. Conservative investors might find their debt-oriented funds appealing, especially given their higher allocation to AA-rated corporate bonds.

faq.q: Where can I find the latest performance data for DSP Pension Fund?
faq.a: The latest performance data, including returns across different asset classes and timeframes for all Pension Fund Managers, is regularly published on the NPS Trust website and the PFRDA website.

fact_check.summary: The article provides a generally accurate overview of DSP Pension Fund within the NPS framework, including tax benefits and investment options, but contains some outdated information regarding the frequency of changing asset allocation.

corrections.note: Corrected the maximum equity allocation for non-government NPS subscribers under Active Choice to reflect the Multiple Scheme Framework, and updated the frequency of asset allocation changes for Active Choice subscribers from twice to four times a financial year.

edits.why: The original statement was incomplete as it did not account for the Multiple Scheme Framework (MSF) introduced in October 2025, which allows for higher equity allocation in specific schemes. The corrected text reflects this update.
NPS subscribers can change their asset allocation four times in a financial year, not twice. The corrected text updates the frequency of asset allocation changes.
